newsitem.title: CHINA: 1,500 firms take part in Shanghai trade fair.
newsitem.headline: 1,500 firms take part in Shanghai trade fair.

text.p: Shanghai opened its fifth annual National Commodities Fair, holding it in the Pudong New Area for the first time, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Sunday.
A total of 1,500 companies are taking part in the four-day fair, displaying household electrical appliances, clothing, foodstuffs, light industrial goods and everyday commodities, it said.
Of the firms, 600 are from Shanghai, 300 are foreign or foreign-invested joint ventures and the rest come from 28 other cities, regions and provinces in China, it said.
The Hong Kong Trade Development Council took part in the fair for the first time, the Shanghai Securities News said.
The fair occupies a space of 50,000 square metres, it said.

The Shanghai city government wants to develop Pudong into the city's commercial centre and is gradually moving its major markets and exchanges into the area, on the east side of the Huangpu river, from the west side.
